We propose a novel deep learning architecture for depth estimation from video that combines the representation ability and scalability of neural networks with geometric principles governing image projection.

1) we propose a differentiable structure-from-motion framework, 2) we demonstrate its effectiveness by achieving state-of-the-art results on the NYUv2 dataset, 3) we show that our approach is able to generalize to unseen scenes and to handle large motions, and 4) we provide a comprehensive evaluation of the components of our approach.
